title: Zero-Day Optical Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) Microcode Lockup
description: Experimental dark-fiber quantum cryptography transponder experiences uncatalogued phase decoherence and microcode lockup. No existing troubleshooting runbook covers this technology. Tests the system's strict grounding and escalation discipline.

alerts.message: Continuous-variable QKD photonic receiver phase variance exceeded Bell-state fidelity threshold (F < 0.62).
Custom cryogenic FPGA coprocessor halted on undocumented vector exception 0xDEADC0DE. Raw registers: RAX=0x41414141.
Quantum key distribution synchronization token ring desynchronized across optical multiplexer port 4.
GPS disciplined oscillator locked to 12 visible GNSS satellites. Time error 4ns.
Periodic RADIUS interim accounting packet flushed: 4,200 records acknowledged.
